akshay: Heads-up — planned maintenance tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC for a NIC driver rollback on a subset of eu-west2 GPU racks. Rolling reboots across 3 cohorts to avoid large capacity loss. Expect ~8-12% capacity dip per cohort for ~10-15m while we evacuate and reboot.

ops-sre: ETA is which night? this week or next?

akshay: Tonight (in ~6h). Doing it during low-traffic window. We'll run cohort A -> B -> C with canary in A (2 nodes) then ramp.

samir: Which pools are in cohort A? any customer-facing high-priority tenants?

akshay: Cohort A = racks r-eu-12-01..04 (gradient pool + a couple of burstable tenants). No priority enterprise customers pinned there per the map. Full roster in the playbook link: https://playbook.internal/maint/6523456789

maria: pls tag support + account execs for those tenants just in case.

akshay: Will do. I'll ping #customer-success when canary passes.

ops-sre: Can we avoid full KV-cache flush on drain? preferring `kvseed` warmbackfill to reduce cold-start p99.

akshay: Yes — plan is: `kubectl cordon <node>` -> `runtask drain --grace 300 --preserve-kvcache` -> move traffic off. Then `kvseed` on the target backfill nodes before uncordon.

julie: Any model-serving regressions expected with driver rollback? quantized models might be sensitive.

samir: We'll run a small smoke against the 2 most-used models (gpt-lite, rerank-v2) in the canary. p95/p99 latency + error-rate are the go/no-go.

deploy-bot: [scheduled] Maintenance window created by akshay for 2026-04-05T02:00:00Z. Auto-reminder 1h and 10m before window.

akshay: Rollout checklist snippet:
```
- canary smoke (2 nodes)
- observe p99 <= baseline + 30ms for 10m
- full cohort drain & reboot (parallel up to 4 nodes)
- kvseed on backfill nodes
- warm traffic handoff, ramp down batch sizes if observed queue depth > 50
- post-check: tracer span error rate <= 0.5% and cost delta <= 2% over 30m
```

maria: Is there a cost concern for extra backfill (burst instances)? budget ok?

akshay: We estimated < $150 extra for the window (temp backfill + cross-zone egress). Finance ok'ed it, CC'd in playbook.

ops-sre: If p99 spikes, what's rollback plan?

akshay: Immediate stop of rollout, rehydrate from snapshot nodes in the previous driver, fallback routing to eu-west1 capacity, and open a P0 with oncall. We'll also revert NAT egress rules if weird.

samir: Metrics to watch (ops dash): `gpu_util`, `kqueue_depth`, `p99_latency`, `kv_miss_rate`, `egress_bytes`. I'll add a pinned alert for `kqueue_depth > 40` per rack.

julie: can we lower default batch_size for the cohorts during the window? want to reduce tail latency risk.

akshay: yes — we'll push a temporary model-serving knob: `batch_size_cap=8` for affected routes. Ops will revert after window.

maria: i'll send a short customer note 30m before if canary passes.

ops-sre: thumbs up. i'll be on watch during the window. call if anything odd. :thumbsup:

akshay: thanks team. will post a quick postmortem if any regressions. final reminder: channel will have live status updates during the window.
